runtime_size: Each sprite is 48 x 64 pixels; original aspect ratio retained; displayed at integer 2x scale with nearest filtering
normalization: Frame the visible alpha silhouette (alpha >= 0.5) to exclude near-transparent outer specks. Preserve original alpha when copying. Previous 32x32 sprites are retained for comparison.
prompt: Create a production game sprite sheet for a cozy fantasy potion shop. Two separate 32x32 logical-pixel sprites arranged exactly side by side in a 64x32 logical-pixel canvas, rendered with perfectly crisp nearest-neighbor enlarged square pixel blocks. Left cell: cute small female potion shopkeeper, plum purple pointed witch hat with tiny brass buckle, mauve dress, cream apron, warm brown hair, rosy face, holding a tiny rose-colored potion in her left hand, front three-quarter view facing slightly right. Right cell: cute adventurer customer wearing a desaturated sage green hood and short cape, beige satchel, face visible in front three-quarter view facing left. Each entire character including hat and shoes must fit inside its own square cell, with 2 logical pixels of transparent padding on all sides, both characters same height and aligned feet. Chibi proportions, readable expressive dark eyes, warm limited 12-color palette, clean dark plum one-pixel outline, traditional authentic low resolution pixel art, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no text, no grid lines, no shadows on ground, no backdrop. The 2-cell sheet must have aspect ratio exactly 2:1. Actual transparent background. Do not add any objects between the characters. These sprites will be reduced to exactly 32x32 pixels per character, so keep silhouettes and pixel clusters extremely simple and aligned.
